positions.name: acme_ops-owner
positions.contribution: Measures the unit's weekly profit, finds its constraint, ranks the works by expected gain, starts them with the positions below and decides their routine.

positions.name: bot_latency
positions.contribution: Measures and cuts the time from a market signal to our order on the exchange: network routes, colocation, the hot path's code, and what a millisecond of lead is worth in won races.

mandate_exit.done_when: the signal-to-order time per venue is measured and its cost in lost races is priced

positions.name: bot_pricing
positions.contribution: Owns how the bot prices its quotes: the spread model, fee tiers, inventory skew, and the backtests that validate a pricing change.

positions.name: bot_risk
positions.contribution: Sets and watches position limits, exposure per venue, the kill switch, and reports risk breaches.

positions.name: data_ledger
positions.contribution: Keeps the ledger of every fill, fee and transfer, and produces the daily and weekly P&L with each cost labelled.

positions.name: data_market
positions.contribution: Captures order books and trades from every venue we trade, keeps their history and its gaps, and serves it to the other positions.

positions.name: infra_hosts
positions.contribution: Runs the servers, the deploy pipeline and the monitoring of the trading hosts; ships the changes other positions make.

positions.name: acme_org
positions.contribution: Keeps the registry: positions, units, mandates and delegations; proposes new positions and mandate changes.
